description: This file defines a class 'MessageOnlyLogFilter' which implements the 'LogNode' interface. It serves as a filter in a logging chain that outputs only log messages without metadata, suitable for simplified on-screen logging.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A class implementing LogNode that filters log output to only include messages.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor accepting a LogNode to chain to, or default constructor.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Outputs messages to the next LogNode in the chain, stripping away metadata.

methods.description: Retrieves the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
